text: 🇲🇽✊ One femicide law for all 32 states. 50 to 70 years in prison. Zero impunity. Sheinbaum confirmed her General Law on Femicide is before Congress this session. It standardizes the crime nationwide — same definition, same protocols, same sentences — ending the patchwork that let cases collapse across state lines. — Gobierno de México initiative, confirmed at the Sept. 3 mañanera The statute is explicit: femicide is committed by "whoever deprives a woman of life for reasons of gender." Penalties reach 70 years. The goal she set on signing it: "zero impunity."
banner: FEMICIDE: ONE LAW, UP TO 70 YEARS

text: 🇲🇽🔍 Homicides down 51% — 44 fewer killings every single day. The security report: intentional homicides have fallen 51% over the administration, and July 2026 was the lowest daily average in 11 years. From Oct. 2024 to July 2026 — 63,000 arrests, 207 priority targets, 32,824 guns seized, 519 tons of drugs, 2,725 clandestine labs dismantled. — Security cabinet report, presented at the mañanera No "war on drugs" spectacle, no mass-incarceration theater — attention to root causes, intelligence, coordination. The numbers are the argument.

🔥🇲🇽 Asked about her political "will," the president said she has no fortune to leave. "I'm giving my inheritance to my children while I'm alive," Sheinbaum said, noting the only property she owns is her home in Coapa. — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Sept. 3 mañanera A sitting president with no hidden estate and no offshore trust — just a house in a working-class part of the capital. Republican austerity here is not a slogan; it's the balance sheet.
banner: "I INHERIT TO MY CHILDREN IN LIFE"

text: 🇲🇽⚖️ Want to be president or governor of Mexico? Hold only one nationality. Sheinbaum confirmed her constitutional initiative is now before Congress: candidates for the presidency or a governorship who hold dual nationality must renounce the foreign one before registering. — Gobierno de México initiative, confirmed at the Sept. 3 mañanera The text is blunt: heading the executive carries "a responsibility directly linked to national sovereignty," which requires "exclusive loyalty." It reforms Articles 82, 116 and 122 and reaches committee Sept. 9.

🔥🇲🇽 No new taxes on beer or cigarettes. They're going after the fuel-tax thieves instead. Sheinbaum ruled out raising the tax on alcohol and tobacco. What the 2027 economic package targets is evasion: "We want the fuel IEPS to be traceable — from import, through distribution, all the way to the sale at the pump." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Sept. 3 mañanera "Huachicol fiscal" — fuel smuggled in mislabeled to dodge the tax — has drained the treasury for years. The package reaches Congress Sept. 8. Collect what's owed, without taxing the family's basket.
banner: FUEL TAX MADE TRACEABLE, NO NEW TAXES

text: 🇲🇽🌎 Sheinbaum and Petro on how the international right rigs elections through the platforms. At the National Palace they discussed "the use of digital platforms to influence election results from abroad, and how the international right has organized to influence different places." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, on her meeting with Gustavo Petro She invited the former Colombian president to lecture at Mexico's Institute of Historical Studies on foreign election interference — the subject of a book he is writing. In Mexico, she noted, the Transformation still holds a large majority.
banner: HOW THE GLOBAL RIGHT RIGS ELECTIONS

text: 🚨🇲🇽 "There is no reason to send our nationals to Central America. None." The U.S. deported more than 2,900 Mexicans to Guatemala, Honduras and Costa Rica — third countries that are not their own. Mexico formally protested to Washington. — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Sept. 3 mañanera 2,568 have already been brought home. Arrivals are received by Mexican consulates and the "México te abraza" program. Mexico takes back its own people — it does not accept them being dumped somewhere else.
banner: US DUMPS 2,900 MEXICANS IN CENTRAL AMERICA

text:
🇲🇽⛽ <u>THE GASOLINAZO ERA IS OVER: MEXICO HOLDS THE LINE ON FUEL</u>

No shock hikes, no gouging. Sheinbaum's government has renewed its pact with fuel retailers to keep regular gasoline near a voluntary ceiling of about 24 pesos a liter — a big reason energy hasn't reignited prices, with headline inflation cooling to 3.12% in July, back within striking distance of Banxico's target. Fuel managed as a public good, not left to the market.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>SHEINBAUM & PETRO: WASHINGTON IS ENGINEERING LATIN AMERICA'S ELECTIONS</u>

Two of Latin America's leftist presidents compared notes on the same threat. Meeting at Mexico's National Palace, Gustavo Petro warned Sheinbaum of a "new artificial political reality" — an interference machine he says is centered in Washington and financed by Israel and drug money, engineered to bend the region's elections. His message to Mexico: watch 2027 and 2030 closely.
